method: Director-side static audit of every control against LABEL.md, man pages on this macOS host, tool existence under /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin, the audited eval items and PR #33 pass-2 reviews, plus a fresh blind audit of the frozen set in three independent sessions. No candidate command was executed.

mismatches.evidence: codesign -d displays the signature, identifier, and signing authority details.

blind_audit.note: The blind audit is diagnostic, not a campaign gate. It identified ct0009 as ambiguous (removed) and confirmed the ct0022/ct0039 replacements; ct0011 was identified by the earlier 7-case audit and removed.

replacement_policy: A control is replaced or removed when its expected label is not defensible from static evidence under LABEL.md, or when a strict blind judge could reasonably reach the other verdict. Replacements come from audited eval items, are statically verified, and are disjoint from the calibration set.
